# 1 Clement Chapter 46 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 46 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_046_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 46

**46:1** So then — let us attach ourselves to those who genuinely practice peace, not to those who only pretend to want it.

**46:2** For Scripture says: "These people honor me with their lips, but their heart is far away from me."

**46:3** And again: "With their mouths they blessed, but in their hearts they cursed."

**46:4** And again: "They loved him with their mouths and lied to him with their tongues; their hearts were not sincere toward him, and they were not faithful to his covenant."

**46:5** Let people like that — with their double hearts — keep their distance from us. Let us be found in the company of those who worship God with a pure heart.

**46:6** For it is written: "Who may go up to the mountain of the LORD? Who may stand in his holy place? The one with clean hands and a pure heart — who has not set his desires on empty things, who has not made false promises to his neighbor."

**46:7** "Such is the generation of those who seek him — those who seek the face of the God of Jacob."

**46:8** And in another place: "Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary and bless the LORD."

**46:9** And: "The LORD is my shepherd; I have everything I need. He makes me lie down in green pastures; he leads me beside quiet waters; he restores my soul. He guides me along right paths for the sake of his name. Even when I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no harm, because you are with me. Your rod and your staff — they comfort me. You prepare a feast for me right in front of my enemies; you anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows. Surely your goodness and mercy will follow me every day of my life, and I will live in the house of the LORD forever."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the spirit of Clement's pastoral appeal.*
